notes: These recipes are frozen expected observations, never execution evidence.
Each profile is selected directly only by the test-only operator comparison; this does not create a consumer command or change the active model.
The fixture describes modeled task states for model-response tests. It is not a trusted host route envelope and does not prove Ticket 3 host behavior.
A response may load only the selected comparison profile. ROUTE cases must still describe the shared public-route matrix; route instructions select profiles, never models.
Use fresh disposable copies of the common repository fixture and preserve all runtime safety and approval gates. Actual unsupported/unavailable operations remain unverified.
